mountingAndAncillaryEquipment.sling: The official M4A1 weight explicitly includes a sling, but no universal sling make/model was established. Preserve sling type/model as unknown unless exact issue/configuration authority is supplied.
mountingAndAncillaryEquipment.boundary: These are platform relationships, not default shooter equipment. They require exact configuration evidence and generally do not belong in an ordinary range setup.

zeroAndTargetChain.grouping: Current Army training material describes two consecutive five-round groups, with four of five rounds within a 6-MOA threshold or 4-MOA objective at 25 m.
zeroAndTargetChain.zeroing: Place four of five rounds in two consecutive groups within the appropriate 6-MOA or 4-MOA area on the A8 zero target at 25 m.
zeroAndTargetChain.confirmationAtDistance: After the 25 m zero, confirm against the properly presented E-type target with at least four of five hits.
zeroAndTargetChain.holdOffApplication: Training material separately tests 100 m and 200 m E-type engagements after confirmation.

deepProfileConclusion: A deep platform profile must resolve weapon variant plus exact sight/optic plus mount/configuration plus ammunition plus zero method plus target plus confirmation evidence. A single 'M4' dropdown value cannot carry that relationship truthfully.
